summary: The rename dialog renders identically when the title field has focus and when Save has focus, although typing, Backspace and paste work only in the field.

The YOLO auto-approval exempts any request that is_plan_permission matches, and that classifier searches the whole serialized request (tool title and rawInput included) for plan markers, so an ordinary tool request containing such strings is not auto-approved.
When the readiness wait fails after the session ID is already in `sessions`, `unanswered_refusal()` suppresses the recorded refusal, so `mj acp` exits 0 even though its only `session/new` failed.

`session/new` now registers with the `creating` tracker only when the `cx.spawn` future first runs, so a disconnect could let `apply_exit_policy` close and drain the tracker before the creation is registered.
Nothing outside tests calls `show_close_failure`, and the diff removed the dashboard's `x` shortcut, so users cannot reach force destroy from the dashboard.

The resume profile picker sets its height to one row per choice and does not scroll. The new '(lossy: text-only transcript)' label makes cross-harness rows wrap at 80 columns, so with many profiles the last choices and the selection marker are cut off.
ReviewDispatch::launch validates each request's hypothesis and then throws it away, so the specialist reviewer never receives the risk it was dispatched for.
The new fourth session_contexts column breaks existing tests that insert three values positionally after migration.
delete_empty_workspace allows deleting the empty 'default' workspace, after which every session-context insert (which relies on DEFAULT 'default') is rejected by the new insert trigger.
assign_new_session_workspace treats any context in 'default' as unassigned, so established or migrated default-workspace sessions can be moved, contrary to its doc comment.
assign_new_session_workspace reads the current workspace and then updates it unconditionally outside a transaction, so two concurrent assignments of the same session can both succeed.
answer_reviewer starts a new self-rescheduling poll loop for the answering turn-review role even though that role's loop is still running, so each answered form adds one more permanent loop.

A poll that finishes before the asynchronous answer is recorded still sees the request as pending, so surface_reviewer_elicitations reopens the answered form, and a later resolution does not dismiss it.

Provisioning creates the worker root with mkdir -p before the worker starts, and create_owner_only_directory leaves an existing directory's mode unchanged, so newly provisioned worker roots stay at the umask default (usually 0755).

A failed logout persistence returns a new 500 that the viewer's sign-out handler never catches or shows, and the in-memory revocation then sends the viewer to the login screen, so the user is not told to retry and the cookie works again after a restart.
Logout with a cookie that has already expired skips revocation and reports success, so a renewal generated just before expiry and delivered after logout installs a valid cookie again.

The revocation deadline is max(presented cookie expiry, now + current TTL), so after a restart with a shorter session_ttl, a cookie renewed earlier under the longer TTL can outlive the revocation and authenticate again.
A logout retry after a failed persist, sent once the presented cookie has expired, reports success without writing the ledger.
The stopped-capacity-poller branch tells the caller to look up reference 'capacity-poller' in the daemon log, but the warning on that path does not contain that reference.

Every error from resolve_local_repository is marked as a precondition refusal, so internal Git failures (Git cannot start, inaccessible directory, timeout, LocalRemoteRepair) reach the caller as a 409 saying to configure a network remote, instead of a 500 with a log reference.
same_installation now calls std::fs::canonicalize, and the Settings TUI runs setup_additions synchronously on its event loop, so a hung profile-home filesystem can freeze the TUI.

When canonicalize fails because a later component is missing, the lexical fallback collapses '..' across symlinks and leaves symlinked prefixes unresolved, so equal homes can compare unequal and different homes can compare equal.
installation_home expands '~' only for the identity check, so a configured '~/...' home now hides the working absolute discovered home while every other consumer still uses the literal '~' path.

For a source adapter that supports session/resume but not loadSession, the runtime resumes without replaying history yet still emits SessionStarted{resumed:true}, so the import exits at once with an empty handoff and loses the selected conversation.
SwitchSession looks up the source role from best-effort provenance instead of passing the role the picker already resolved, so a missing record resumes with the active agent.
Deleting embedded_npm_recipes_match_the_runtime_pins leaves no check that the embedded Codex/Claude package.json files match the pins in harness_runtime.rs.

Deleting a_harness_restart_gates_dispatch_until_the_session_is_configured_again drops the only test that the session_configured dispatch gate closes on HarnessRestarting and reopens on SessionConfigured.
Deleting daemon_restart_without_a_baseline_does_not_hide_pending_work drops the only test that a restart with existing relay state does not create a fresh review baseline.
Deleting github_token_requests_install_and_remove_connection_only_state drops handler-level coverage of the GitHub token requests.

verify_docker classifies any 'Cannot connect to the Docker daemon' stderr as NotRunning and advises 'Start Docker', even when the cause is an unreachable or misconfigured endpoint (DOCKER_HOST or a remote context).
A prompt submitted while a config update is in flight is silently dropped by the runtime after the UI already entered Streaming, leaving the UI stuck.
refresh_config_picker keeps the picker selection as numeric indices, so a config update that reorders or removes options while the picker is open can make Enter apply a value to a different option.
The picker's height formula (rows + 4) leaves out one of the five fixed rows (2 borders, 2 header rows, 1 footer), so the modal is one row short.
The inline autocomplete popover would cover the new queued-steer chip row.
The quota row now asks for every wrapped line as an unbounded Constraint::Length, which could take space from the chat input when the label wraps to many lines.
The new failed-session dialog puts the full error before the explanation and buttons, and the popup is capped at terminal height with no scrolling, so a long error hides the actions.
A deferred manual checkpoint persists the cleared last_checkpoint_error, hiding an earlier real failure.
A prompted turn followed by a self-started turn before the next view loses the automatic review.
A same-ordinal digest mismatch between the ready cursor and the latched projection is treated as a deferral rather than an integrity error.
An idle observation consumed while the deferred copy is still in flight is not revisited after the deferral clears last_attempted_turn.
The startup summary applies an unread count computed from a viewed ordinal captured at spawn time, so already-read messages can show as unread again.
The summary loader reads the session row and transcript rows in separate autocommit statements, so the result can mix two projection commits.
The last-user-message query requires a user:/user- stable ID prefix, so user items with other IDs are skipped.
SQLite one-argument trim() strips only spaces, so newline- or tab-only agent messages pass the SQL filter, unlike Rust's str::trim in the full projection.

A legacy Row position saved by the previous build while its prefix was still loading (or after prefix conversion failed) is tail-relative, but the new reader treats every legacy Row index as a full-history index and restores the wrong entry.

Concurrent or overlapping setup workers share one fixed <file>.part path per model file; one worker unlinks and recreates it, and the other can rename that still-growing file into place, so a truncated nonempty model can be installed and accepted.
The new setup title puts the long per-file download message before the percentage and the 'Ctrl-R stop' hint, so the block border clips both on narrower terminals.
While the agent is streaming, cancelling, or forking, busy_prompt_title takes precedence, so the new setup status is not shown.
Sessions found only by title or project match now come back with no preview, so the resume dialog's archived rows lose their descriptive text.
Recovery and parked sub-agent wake compare the host worker's digest with the image worker behind the hel link and replace the link with a full host copy.
The ignored Docker integration test assumes agent-dev:latest has no worker, which stops being true once this change publishes :latest with one.
build-agent-dev-image.sh warns but still labels a worker built from uncommitted changes with the committed build identity.
A dangling symlink at /opt/mjolnir/mj-worker makes the probe report 'absent' instead of an error.

The rename's 15-second SAVE_ACK_TIMEOUT covers the local Controller::load reload as well as the daemon acknowledgement, so a slow reload after a successful rename is reported as an unconfirmed save and the new controller is thrown away.

On SSH-bare and EC2 targets the controller records the dispatcher command under a relative worker root, but the worker compares it against its absolute root, so is_review_dispatch never matches and Guardian never preapproves the owned review dispatcher.
The wide minimized Sessions title shows 'Attention: N' without the most urgent level's glyph, while the compact forms include it.
An unreachable worker returns Unreachable before a failed review is examined, so the failed review is ranked below Failed.
The runtime task records Failed directly, while SessionStarted reaches the reporter through the orchestrator, so a quick post-start exit can record a launch failure for a session that started.
The 64-record cap evicts the oldest launch even while it is still Starting, which loses its eventual outcome.
On phone widths with an empty composer, moving keyboard focus from the editor to Send or Attach removes composer-has-intent and hides the actions that are receiving focus.
Claim that the existing 25dvh outer limit on #conversation-side clips the new 40dvh inner scroller on phones and creates nested scrolling.
Claim that display: block on #earlier-messages overrides its hidden attribute when there is no earlier page.
ClipboardTarget::Answer holds only the request ID, so a clipboard result that arrives after the user moves to another field of the same question is pasted into the newly focused field.
adopt_restarted_checkpoint_relay falls back to a standalone connection when the post-restart lease fails, bypassing actor exclusivity.
The actor is unleased during the whole worker restart in open_checkpoint_relay, so a prompt submitted then can reach the restarted worker before the checkpoint leases and latches.
worker_connect_needs_restart does not recognize 'write relay hello request: Broken pipe', so Stop still fails without restarting a dead worker when the proxy exits before the hello is written.

muse_data_dir decides whether a home is the person's own Muse home by comparing paths as text, so a symlinked or otherwise equivalent home spelling looks under <home>/.data/muse and misses the catalog interactive Muse saved in XDG data.
A catalog deleted from the source stays in an existing session home, because the local stage install merges the stage without removing omitted files.
On a timeout or other panic in native_muse_turn, the caller's TempDir (holding copied auth.json) is removed while the spawned ACP runtime, adapter and native Muse process are still alive.

The pinned field title is drawn as an unwrapped one-row Paragraph, so a title wider than the pane (or containing a newline) is clipped and its remainder, including the '(required)' marker, can no longer be reached by scrolling.
With a two-row body, the new layout gives both rows to the field and leaves the request message zero rows, where the old layout kept one message row.
apply_worker_summary replaces the summarized unread count but keeps unread_agent_message_sequences, so after a worker reconnect the row counts already-tracked unread messages twice.
When the hydrating summary arrives, it counts unread messages for the selected, expanded active session even though the live event path treats that session's messages as read.
A model or effort chip that is only partly inside the border is still drawn in chip style but gets no hitbox, so clicking its visible part does nothing.
Chip hitboxes are checked against the full border width, but the right-aligned activity title is drawn over the same cells, so clicking the spinner can open the model or effort picker.
